```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
```

Load libraries

```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
```


Load data
```{r}
age <- read.table("agedays.txt", header = TRUE)
age <- as.data.frame(age)


age$disease_onset <- ifelse(age$AGEDYS < 7, "EOD",
                      ifelse(age$AGEDYS <= 89, "LOD", "VLOD"))

age_NL <- read.table("phenotypes_NL_EOD_LOD.txt",header = TRUE)
age_TW <- read.table("phenotypes_tw.txt",header = TRUE)


```

Distribution of age

```{r}

ggplot(age, aes(x = AGEDYS)) +
  geom_histogram(binwidth = 7, fill = "skyblue", color = "black") +
  geom_vline(xintercept = c(7, 90, 365), color = "red", linetype = "dashed", size = 1) +
  labs(title = "Age Distribution", x = "Age in Days", y = "Count") +
  theme_minimal()

ggplot(age, aes(x = disease_onset)) +
  geom_bar(fill = "steelblue") +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(title = "Number of Cases by Disease Onset",
       x = "Disease Onset",
       y = "Number of Cases")


```

Combined dataset EOD LOD plots

```{r}
# Recode and label age_NL
age_NL <- age_NL %>%
  mutate(disease_onset = ifelse(binary == 0, "EOD", "LOD"),
         region = "Netherlands")

# Recode and label age_TW
age_TW <- age_TW %>%
  mutate(disease_onset = ifelse(binary == 0, "EOD", "LOD"),
         region = "Taiwan")

# Label age (assumes it already has a disease_onset column)
age <- age %>%
  mutate(region = "CDC ABCs")

# Bind all dataframes
combined_age <- bind_rows(age, age_NL, age_TW)

ggplot(combined_age, aes(x = disease_onset, fill = disease_onset)) +
  geom_bar(width = 0.7, color = "black") +
  facet_wrap(~ region) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("EOD" = "#4DAF4A", "LOD" = "#377EB8", "VLOD" = "#E41A1C")) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
  theme(
    strip.text = element_text(face = "bold", size = 16),
    axis.title = element_text(size = 14),
    axis.text = element_text(size = 12),
    legend.position = "none",
    panel.grid.major.x = element_blank()
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Number of Cases by Disease Onset Across Regions",
    x = "Disease Onset",
    y = "Number of Cases"
  )
```

CDC Site of Isolation

```{r}
isolation <- read.table("column8_counts.txt")
isolation <- isolation[-1,]

iso_df <- do.call(rbind, strsplit(isolation, ",")) |> as.data.frame()
colnames(iso_df) <- c("Site of Isolation", "Count") 

iso_df$Count <- as.numeric(as.character(iso_df$Count))

iso_df <- iso_df[order(iso_df$Count, decreasing = TRUE), ]

# Plot


ggplot(iso_df, aes(x = reorder(`Site of Isolation`, Count), y = Count, fill = `Site of Isolation`)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", color = "black", width = 0.7) +
  coord_flip() +
  scale_fill_brewer(palette = "Set3") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
  theme(
    legend.position = "none",
    axis.text = element_text(size = 12),
    axis.title = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold"),
    plot.title = element_text(size = 16, face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),
    panel.grid.major.y = element_blank()
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "CDC ABCs Sample Counts by Isolation Site",
    x = "Site of Isolation",
    y = "Number of Samples"
  )

```

Collection Date for CDC, Taiwan, Netheralnds 


```{r}

taiwan_md <- read.csv("Taiwan_metadata.csv", header = TRUE)
netherlands_md <- read.csv("Netherlands_metadata.csv", header = TRUE)

tw_year_df <- as.data.frame(table(taiwan_md$Collection_Date))
colnames(tw_year_df) <- c("Year", "Count")


nl_year_df <- as.data.frame(table(netherlands_md$Year.of.sampling))
colnames(nl_year_df) <- c("Year", "Count")



cdc_year <- read.table("column5_counts.txt")
cdc_year <- cdc_year[-1,]

cdc_year_df <- do.call(rbind, strsplit(cdc_year, ",")) |> as.data.frame()
colnames(cdc_year_df) <- c("Year", "Count") 

cdc_year_df$Count <- as.numeric(as.character(cdc_year_df$Count))


# Add source labels
cdc_year_df <- cdc_year_df %>%
  mutate(Source = "CDC ABCs")

nl_year_df <- nl_year_df %>%
  mutate(Source = "Netherlands")

tw_year_df <- tw_year_df %>%
  mutate(Source = "Taiwan")

# Combine all into one dataframe
combined_df <- bind_rows(cdc_year_df, nl_year_df, tw_year_df)

# Ensure Year is treated as a factor for discrete x-axis, or numeric for continuous
combined_df$Year <- as.factor(combined_df$Year)

# Plot
ggplot(combined_df, aes(x = Year, y = Count, fill = Source)) +
  geom_col(width = 0.7, color = "black") +
  scale_y_continuous(expand = c(0, 0)) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
  labs(
    title = "Sample Counts by Year Across Regions",
    x = "Year",
    y = "Number of Samples",
    fill = "Region"
  ) +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
    legend.position = "bottom",
    legend.title = element_text(size = 13),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 12)
  ) +
  scale_fill_brewer(palette = "Set2")


```

Serotype distribution across dataframes (CDC, NL, TW)


```{r}
cdc_st <- read.table("column9_counts.txt")
cdc_st <- cdc_st[-1,]

cdc_st_df <- do.call(rbind, strsplit(cdc_st, ",")) |> as.data.frame()
colnames(cdc_st_df) <- c("Serotype", "Count") 

cdc_st_df$Count <- as.numeric(as.character(cdc_st_df$Count))

tw_st_df <- data.frame(
  Serotype = c("IA", "IB", "II", "III","V","VI","VII"),
  Count = c(104,22,7,147,10,10,1)
)

nl_st_df <- data.frame(
  Serotype = c("IA","IB","II","III","IV","V","VI","VII","IX","NT"),
  Count = c(260,84,74,815,29,63,5,2,4,2)
)


# Add source labels
cdc_st_df <- cdc_st_df %>%
  mutate(Source = "CDC ABCs")

nl_st_df <- nl_st_df %>%
  mutate(Source = "Netherlands")

tw_st_df <- tw_st_df %>%
  mutate(Source = "Taiwan")

# Combine all into one dataframe
combined_df <- bind_rows(cdc_st_df, nl_st_df, tw_st_df)

# Ensure Year is treated as a factor for discrete x-axis, or numeric for continuous
combined_df$Serotype <- as.factor(combined_df$Serotype)

# Plot
ggplot(combined_df, aes(x = Serotype, y = Count, fill = Source)) +
  geom_col(width = 0.7, color = "black", show.legend = FALSE) +
  facet_wrap(~ Source, scales = "free_y") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 1000), expand = c(0, 0)) +
  labs(title = "Sample Counts by Serotype Across Regions",
       x = "Serotype",
       y = "Number of Samples") +
  theme(
    strip.text = element_text(size = 16, face = "bold"),
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1)
  ) +
  scale_fill_brewer(palette = "Set2")

```

PanGWAS Results 

Pipeline 1

CDC_EOD_LOD 

```{r}
#Panaroo eggnog annotations
panaroo_eggnog <- read.table("EOD_LOD_CDC_panaroo.annotations", 
                             header = FALSE, sep = "\t", fill = TRUE)

colnames(panaroo_eggnog)[1] <- "variant"
#Roary eggnog annotations 

roary_eggnog <- read.table("EOD_LOD_CDC_roary.annotations", 
                             header = FALSE, sep = "\t", fill = TRUE)

#Panaroo pyseer results
panaroo_pyseer <- read.table("PanGWAS_Panaroo_Fasttree_EOD_LOD_CDC.txt", 
                             header = TRUE, sep = "\t", fill = TRUE)

alpha_bon_panaroo <- 0.05/nrow(panaroo_pyseer)
#Roary pyseer results 
roary_pyseer <- read.table("PanGWAS_Roary_Fasttree_EOD_LOD_CDC.txt", 
                             header = TRUE, sep = "\t", fill = TRUE)

alpha_bon_roary <- 0.05/nrow(roary_pyseer)


#Functional distribution of significant panaroo cogs

sig_hits_panaroo <- panaroo_pyseer[panaroo_pyseer$lrt.pvalue < alpha_bon_panaroo, ]

matching_annotations_panaroo <- merge(sig_hits_panaroo, panaroo_eggnog[, c(1, 7)], by = "variant")
colnames(matching_annotations_panaroo)[9] <- "Functional Group" #not all hits where in panaroo_eggnog

#Functional distribution of significant roary cogs

sig_hits_roary <- roary_pyseer[roary_pyseer$lrt.pvalue < alpha_bon_roary, ] #some significant but idk how to compare to eggnog results 




```


Pipeline 2

CDC_EOD_LOD_VLOD 

```{r}

#Panaroo eggnog annotations
panaroo_eggnog <- read.table("EOD_LOD_VLOD_CDC_panaroo.annotations", 
                             header = FALSE, sep = "\t", fill = TRUE)

colnames(panaroo_eggnog)[1] <- "variant"
#Roary eggnog annotations 

roary_eggnog <- read.table("EOD_LOD_VLOD_CDC_roary.annotations", 
                             header = FALSE, sep = "\t", fill = TRUE)

#Panaroo pyseer results
panaroo_pyseer <- read.table("PanGWAS_Panaroo_Fasttree_EOD_LOD_VLOD_CDC.txt", 
                             header = TRUE, sep = "\t", fill = TRUE)

alpha_bon_panaroo <- 0.05/nrow(panaroo_pyseer)
#Roary pyseer results 
roary_pyseer <- read.table("PanGWAS_Roary_Fasttree_EOD_LOD_VLOD_CDC.txt", 
                             header = TRUE, sep = "\t", fill = TRUE)

alpha_bon_roary <- 0.05/nrow(roary_pyseer)

#Functional distribution of significant panaroo cogs

# Filter for significant COGs
sig_hits_panaroo <- panaroo_pyseer[panaroo_pyseer$lrt.pvalue < alpha_bon_panaroo, ]

matching_annotations_panaroo <- merge(sig_hits_panaroo, panaroo_eggnog[, c(1, 7)], by = "variant")
colnames(matching_annotations_panaroo)[9] <- "Functional Group" # different distribution of cogs? 

#Functional distribution of significant roary cogs

sig_hits_roary <- roary_pyseer[roary_pyseer$lrt.pvalue < alpha_bon_roary, ] #none were significant 


```

Panaroo Vs CLARC Sub analysis results 

Pipeline 1 

CDC_EOD_LOD

```{r}

#Panaroo pyseer results
panaroo_pyseer <- read.table("PanGWAS_Panaroo_Fasttree_EOD_LOD_CDC.txt", 
                             header = TRUE, sep = "\t", fill = TRUE)

#Panaroo + CLARC  pyseer results
panaroo_pyseer_CLARC <- read.table("PanGWAS_Panaroo_CLARC_Fasttree_EOD_LOD_CDC.txt", 
                             header = TRUE, sep = "\t", fill = TRUE)


#Bonferonni Correction (Did we do clarc right?)
alpha_bon_panaroo <- 0.05/nrow(panaroo_pyseer)


alpha_bon_panaroo_CLARC <- 0.05/nrow(panaroo_pyseer_CLARC)


sig_hits_panaroo <- panaroo_pyseer[panaroo_pyseer$lrt.pvalue < alpha_bon_panaroo, ]


sig_hits_panaroo_CLARC <- panaroo_pyseer_CLARC[panaroo_pyseer_CLARC$lrt.pvalue < alpha_bon_panaroo_CLARC, ]


```

QQ Plots

Pipeline 1

CDC_EOD_LOD

```{r}

# Load necessary library
library(qqman)

# Read in the Pyseer output
panaroo_pyseer <- read.table("PanGWAS_Panaroo_Fasttree_EOD_LOD_CDC.txt", 
                             header = TRUE, sep = "\t", fill = TRUE)

# Extract p-values (use 'lrt-pvalue' or 'filter-pvalue')
pvals <- panaroo_pyseer$lrt.pvalue  # or use pyseer_results$filter.pvalue

# Remove NA or invalid values
pvals <- pvals[!is.na(pvals) & pvals > 0 & pvals <= 1]

# QQ plot
qq(pvals, main = "QQ Plot of Pyseer Pan-GWAS P-values Panaroo EOD LOD CDC",xlim = c(0, 10),ylim = c(0,10))

```

Pipeline 1 IQTree Visualization core tree file 

ST Tips 

```{r}
library(ggtree)
library(treeio)
library(tidyverse)

# Load the tree
tree <- read.tree("core_tree.treefile")

# Load your metadata file (CSV or TSV) with sample names and CC/ST info
# Make sure the first column is the tip label (e.g., SampleID), and columns for CC and/or ST
metadata <- read.table("ST.txt", sep = "\t", header = FALSE, fill = TRUE, comment.char = "")
colnames(metadata) <- c("SampleID","ST")

# Assuming metadata has a column 'SampleID' and either 'CC' or 'ST'
tree_data <- full_join(as_tibble(tree), metadata, by = c("label" = "SampleID"))

# Color by ST
ggtree(tree) %<+% metadata +
  geom_tippoint(aes(color = ST), size = 2) +
  theme_tree2() +
  labs(color = "Sequence Type")



```

Serotype tips 

```{r}
library(ggtree)
library(treeio)
library(tidyverse)

# Load the tree
tree <- read.tree("core_tree.treefile")

# Load your metadata file (CSV or TSV) with sample names and CC/ST info
# Make sure the first column is the tip label (e.g., SampleID), and columns for CC and/or ST
metadata <- read.table("Serotype.txt", sep = "\t", header = FALSE, fill = TRUE, comment.char = "")
colnames(metadata) <- c("SampleID","Serotype")

# Assuming metadata has a column 'SampleID' and either 'CC' or 'ST'
tree_data <- full_join(as_tibble(tree), metadata, by = c("label" = "SampleID"))

# Color by ST
ggtree(tree) %<+% metadata +
  geom_tippoint(aes(color = Serotype), size = 2) +
  theme_tree2() +
  labs(color = "Serotype")



```

EOD/LOD tips 

```{r}
library(ggtree)
library(treeio)
library(tidyverse)

# Load the tree
tree <- read.tree("core_tree.treefile")

# Load your metadata file (CSV or TSV) with sample names and CC/ST info

colnames(metadata) <- c("SampleID","EOD","Continuous")

# Assuming metadata has a column 'SampleID' and either 'CC' or 'ST'
tree_data <- full_join(as_tibble(tree), metadata, by = c("label" = "SampleID"))

# Color by ST
ggtree(tree) %<+% metadata +
  geom_tippoint(aes(color = EOD), size = 2) +
  theme_tree2() +
  labs(color = "EOD/LOD")
```

SNP Variant Calling Pipeline 1

```{r}
library(ggplot2)
library(readr)
library(dplyr)
library(forcats)

# Read your per-sample counts
counts <- read_tsv("snpeff_effect_counts_per_sample.tsv",
                   col_names = c("sample", "effect", "count"))

# --- Simplify: keep top 10 effect types across all samples ---
top_effects <- counts %>%
  group_by(effect) %>%
  summarise(total = sum(count)) %>%
  arrange(desc(total)) %>%
  slice_head(n = 10) %>%
  pull(effect)

counts_simplified <- counts %>%
  mutate(effect_grouped = ifelse(effect %in% top_effects, effect, "Other")) %>%
  group_by(sample, effect_grouped) %>%
  summarise(count = sum(count), .groups = "drop")

# --- Order effects by overall abundance ---
effect_order <- counts_simplified %>%
  group_by(effect_grouped) %>%
  summarise(total = sum(count)) %>%
  arrange(desc(total)) %>%
  pull(effect_grouped)

counts_simplified <- counts_simplified %>%
  mutate(effect_grouped = factor(effect_grouped, levels = effect_order))

# --- Plot ---
p <- ggplot(counts_simplified, aes(x = sample, y = count, fill = effect_grouped)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity") +
  labs(title = "Top SnpEff Variant Effects per Sample",
       x = "Sample", y = "Variant Count", fill = "Effect Type") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, vjust = 0.5, hjust=1),
        legend.position = "right")
p

```

Rooted Fasttree phylogeny 

Rooting checks 

```{r}

# install.packages("ape") # if needed
library(ape)

f <- "GBS_GWAS_FastTree_phylo_rooted_GAS.tre"
tr <- read.tree(f)

# 1) Is the tree marked as rooted?
is.rooted(tr)

# 2) Is your outgroup tip present?
"SRR32569359" %in% tr$tip.label

# 3) Does rooting on SRR32569359 change anything? (It shouldn't if already rooted correctly)
tr_check <- root(tr, outgroup = "SRR32569359", resolve.root = TRUE)
all.equal.phylo(tr, tr_check)   # should be TRUE (or nearly TRUE)

# 4) Is SRR32569359 sister to all others? (clade size should be 1)
mrca_node <- getMRCA(tr, c("SRR32569359", setdiff(tr$tip.label, "SRR32569359")[1]))
# The MRCA of outgroup + any other tip should be the root node if correctly rooted:
mrca_node == Nnode(tr) + 1

```

```{r}
library(ape)
library(ggtree)
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(phangorn)

# --- inputs ---
tree_file  <- "GBS_GWAS_FastTree_phylo_rooted_GAS.tre"
pheno_file <- "phenotypes_CDC_EOD_LOD_VLOD.txt"
out_pattern <- "SRR32569359"  # pattern matching your GAS/outgroup tip

# --- read tree & drop outgroup ---
tr  <- read.tree(tree_file)
OUT <- grep(out_pattern, tr$tip.label, value = TRUE)[1]

# Remove any stored root-edge stub (just a visual thing)
if (!is.null(tr$root.edge)) tr$root.edge <- NULL

# Drop the outgroup tip if present
if (!is.na(OUT) && OUT %in% tr$tip.label) {
  tr <- drop.tip(tr, OUT)
}

# Midpoint-root and tidy
tr <- phangorn::midpoint(tr)
tr <- ladderize(tr, right = TRUE)

# --- read phenotypes & build annotation for remaining tips ---
ph <- read.table(pheno_file, header = TRUE, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
# your file has 3 cols; you keep 1 & 2 and rename
ph <- ph[, -3]
colnames(ph) <- c("accession", "pheno")

# keep only tips that remain after dropping OUT
ph <- ph[ph$accession %in% tr$tip.label, , drop = FALSE]

anno <- data.frame(label = tr$tip.label) %>%
  left_join(ph, by = c("label" = "accession")) %>%
  mutate(group = ifelse(pheno == 0, "EOD",
                 ifelse(!is.na(pheno), "LOD/VLOD", NA)))  # NA for missing

# --- plot: fan layout, colored tips ---
p <- ggtree(tr, layout = "fan", open.angle = 120) %<+% anno +
  geom_tippoint(aes(color = group), size = 0.8, stroke = 0) +
  scale_color_manual(
    values = c("EOD" = "#377eb8", "LOD/VLOD" = "#e41a1c"),
    na.value = "grey70",
    name = "Phenotype"
  ) +
  theme_tree2() +
  ggtitle("GBS FastTree (OUT dropped; midpoint-rooted; colored by EOD vs LOD/VLOD)") +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold"),
        legend.position = "right")

print(p)
```

Full Phylogeny for publication

```{r}
# ---- libraries ----
library(ape)
library(ggtree)
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(phangorn)
library(scales)

# ---- inputs ----
tree_file   <- "GBS_GWAS_FastTree_phylo_rooted_GAS.tre"
pheno_file  <- "phenotypes_CDC_EOD_LOD_VLOD.txt"
st_file     <- "ST.txt"
sero_file   <- "Serotype.txt"
out_pattern <- "SRR32569359"

# ---- layout settings ----
heatmap_offset <- 0.006
heatmap_width  <- 0.12
tip_size       <- 0.7
st_top_n       <- 15      # set to NULL to keep all STs

# helper: choose legend grid with spare slots
calc_grid <- function(k, min_cols = 2L, max_cols = 12L) {
  if (k <= 1L) return(list(nrow = 1L, ncol = 1L))
  ncol <- max(min_cols, min(max_cols, k))
  nrow <- ceiling(k / ncol)
  if (nrow * ncol <= k) ncol <- min(max_cols, ncol + 1L)
  list(nrow = nrow, ncol = ncol)
}

# ---- read tree ----
tr  <- read.tree(tree_file)
OUT <- grep(out_pattern, tr$tip.label, value = TRUE)[1]
if (!is.null(tr$root.edge)) tr$root.edge <- NULL
if (!is.na(OUT) && OUT %in% tr$tip.label) tr <- drop.tip(tr, OUT)
tr <- phangorn::midpoint(tr)
tr <- ladderize(tr, right = TRUE)

# ---- read phenotype ----
ph <- read.table(pheno_file, header = TRUE, sep = "", stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
ph <- ph[, 1:2]; colnames(ph) <- c("accession", "pheno")
ph <- ph %>% mutate(Onset = ifelse(pheno == 0, "EOD", "LOD/VLOD")) %>% select(accession, Onset)

# ---- read ST & Serotype ----
st_tab   <- read.table(st_file,   header = FALSE, sep = "", stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
sero_tab <- read.table(sero_file, header = FALSE, sep = "", stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
colnames(st_tab)   <- c("accession", "ST")
colnames(sero_tab) <- c("accession", "serotype")

# ---- merge ----
anno <- data.frame(label = tr$tip.label, stringsAsFactors = FALSE) %>%
  left_join(ph,      by = c("label" = "accession")) %>%
  left_join(st_tab,  by = c("label" = "accession")) %>%
  left_join(sero_tab,by = c("label" = "accession"))
anno$ST <- as.character(anno$ST)

# ---- collapse rare STs (optional) ----
if (!is.null(st_top_n)) {
  st_counts <- table(anno$ST)
  keep_st   <- names(sort(st_counts, decreasing = TRUE))[seq_len(min(st_top_n, length(st_counts)))]
  anno$ST   <- ifelse(is.na(anno$ST), NA_character_,
                      ifelse(anno$ST %in% keep_st, anno$ST, "Other"))
}

# ---- heatmap data ----
heat_df <- anno %>% transmute(label, Onset, Serotype = serotype)
row.names(heat_df) <- heat_df$label
heat_df <- heat_df[tr$tip.label, c("Onset","Serotype"), drop = FALSE]

# ---- palettes ----
# ST palette
st_levels <- sort(unique(na.omit(anno$ST)))
st_levels <- c(setdiff(st_levels, "Other"), intersect("Other", st_levels))
st_cols   <- setNames(hue_pal()(length(st_levels)), st_levels)
if ("Other" %in% names(st_cols)) st_cols["Other"] <- "#7f7f7f"

# heatmap palettes (put Onset first)
onset_cols  <- c("EOD" = "#1f78b4", "LOD/VLOD" = "#e31a1c")  # strong, opaque
sero_levels <- sort(unique(na.omit(heat_df$Serotype)))
sero_cols   <- setNames(hue_pal()(length(sero_levels)), sero_levels)
heat_cols   <- c(onset_cols, sero_cols)

# legend breaks: force EOD & LOD/VLOD first (side-by-side), then serotypes, then NA if present
fill_breaks <- c(names(onset_cols), sero_levels)
fill_breaks <- intersect(names(heat_cols), fill_breaks)
cg_fill  <- calc_grid(length(fill_breaks), min_cols = 2L, max_cols = 14L)

# ST legend sizing
cg_color <- calc_grid(length(st_levels), min_cols = 6L, max_cols = 14L)

# ---- tree ----
p <- ggtree(tr, layout = "rectangular") %<+% anno +
  geom_tippoint(aes(color = ST), size = tip_size) +
  scale_color_manual(values = st_cols, na.value = "grey60", name = "ST") +
  theme_tree2() +
  ggtitle("GBS phylogeny (tips colored by ST) with onset & serotype heatmap") +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.02, face = "bold"),
    legend.position = "bottom",
    legend.title = element_text(size = 8),
    legend.text  = element_text(size = 6),
    legend.key.size = unit(0.4, "lines"),
    legend.box = "vertical",
    legend.spacing.y = unit(1, "pt"),
    axis.line.x = element_blank(),
    axis.text.x = element_blank(),
    axis.ticks.x = element_blank(),
    axis.title.x = element_blank()
  ) +
  guides(
    color = guide_legend(
      title = "ST",
      nrow = cg_color$nrow,
      ncol = cg_color$ncol,
      byrow = TRUE,
      override.aes = list(size = 2)
    )
  )

# ---- heatmap (SOLID fills; no borders = no “washed out” look) ----
p_heat <- gheatmap(
  p, heat_df,
  offset = heatmap_offset,
  width  = heatmap_width,
  color  = NA,           # <— removes tile borders so colors look fully opaque
  colnames = TRUE,
  colnames_angle = 90,
  font.size = 2.8,
  hjust = 0
) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = heat_cols, breaks = fill_breaks, name = NULL) +
  guides(
    fill = guide_legend(
      title = NULL,
      nrow = cg_fill$nrow,
      ncol = cg_fill$ncol,  # ensures EOD & LOD/VLOD appear next to each other
      byrow = TRUE,
      override.aes = list(size = 2.5)
    )
  ) +
  theme(
    legend.position = "bottom",
    legend.text = element_text(size = 6),
    legend.key.size = unit(0.4, "lines"),
    legend.box = "vertical"
  )

print(p_heat)
```

```{r}
# ---- read tree ----
```

```{r}
# ---- libraries ----
library(ape)
library(ggtree)
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(phangorn)
library(scales)

# ---- inputs ----
tree_file   <- "GBS_GWAS_FastTree_phylo_rooted_GAS.tre"
pheno_file  <- "phenotypes_CDC_EOD_LOD_VLOD.txt"   # cols: accession, pheno(0/1), onset_days
sero_file   <- "Serotype.txt"                      # cols: accession, Serotype
cc_file     <- "CC_clusters.txt"                   # cols: accession, CC
out_pattern <- "SRR32569359"

# ---- layout settings ----
heatmap_offset <- 0.006
heatmap_width  <- 0.14
tip_size       <- 0.7

# helper: legend grid
calc_grid <- function(k, min_cols = 2L, max_cols = 12L) {
  if (k <= 1L) return(list(nrow = 1L, ncol = 1L))
  ncol <- max(min_cols, min(max_cols, k))
  nrow <- ceiling(k / ncol)
  if (nrow * ncol <= k) ncol <- min(max_cols, ncol + 1L)
  list(nrow = nrow, ncol = ncol)
}

# ---- read tree ----
tr  <- read.tree(tree_file)
OUT <- grep(out_pattern, tr$tip.label, value = TRUE)[1]
if (!is.null(tr$root.edge)) tr$root.edge <- NULL
if (!is.na(OUT) && OUT %in% tr$tip.label) tr <- drop.tip(tr, OUT)
tr <- phangorn::midpoint(tr)
tr <- ladderize(tr, right = TRUE)

# ---- read phenotype (now using third column = onset days) ----
# Expect at least 3 columns; keep first 3
ph_raw <- read.table(pheno_file, header = TRUE, sep = "", stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
ph     <- ph_raw[, 1:3]
colnames(ph) <- c("accession", "pheno_bin", "onset_days")

# Make 7-day bins: [0,7), [7,14), ...
max_days   <- suppressWarnings(max(ph$onset_days, na.rm = TRUE))
max_days   <- ifelse(is.finite(max_days), max_days, 0)
breaks     <- seq(0, ceiling((max_days + 1)/7) * 7, by = 7)  # right-open bins
labels_wk  <- paste0(breaks[-length(breaks)], "\u2013", breaks[-1] - 1, "d")  # e.g., "0–6d"
ph <- ph %>%
  mutate(
    WeekBin = cut(onset_days, breaks = breaks, labels = labels_wk, right = FALSE),
    WeekBin = addNA(WeekBin)
  )
levels(ph$WeekBin)[is.na(levels(ph$WeekBin))] <- "Unknown"

# ---- read Serotype & CC ----
sero_tab <- read.table(sero_file, header = FALSE, sep = "", stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
colnames(sero_tab) <- c("accession", "Serotype")

cc_tab <- read.table(cc_file, header = FALSE, sep = "", stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
colnames(cc_tab) <- c("accession", "CC")

# ---- merge ----
anno <- data.frame(label = tr$tip.label, stringsAsFactors = FALSE) %>%
  left_join(ph[, c("accession","WeekBin")], by = c("label" = "accession")) %>%
  left_join(sero_tab, by = c("label" = "accession")) %>%
  left_join(cc_tab,   by = c("label" = "accession"))

# ---- heatmap data: WeekBin + CC ----
heat_df <- anno %>% transmute(label, WeekBin, CC)
row.names(heat_df) <- heat_df$label
heat_df <- heat_df[tr$tip.label, c("WeekBin", "CC"), drop = FALSE]

# ---- palettes ----
# Tips colored by Serotype
sero_levels <- sort(unique(na.omit(anno$Serotype)))
sero_cols   <- setNames(hue_pal()(length(sero_levels)), sero_levels)

# Heatmap palettes
week_levels <- levels(heat_df$WeekBin)
week_cols   <- setNames(hue_pal()(length(week_levels)), week_levels)
if ("Unknown" %in% names(week_cols)) week_cols["Unknown"] <- "#bdbdbd"

cc_levels   <- sort(unique(na.omit(heat_df$CC)))
cc_cols     <- setNames(hue_pal()(length(cc_levels)), cc_levels)

heat_cols   <- c(week_cols, cc_cols)
fill_breaks <- c(week_levels, cc_levels)
cg_fill     <- calc_grid(length(fill_breaks), min_cols = 4L, max_cols = 14L)

# ---- tree (tips colored by Serotype) ----
p <- ggtree(tr, layout = "rectangular") %<+% anno +
  geom_tippoint(aes(color = Serotype), size = tip_size) +
  scale_color_manual(values = sero_cols, na.value = "grey60", name = "Serotype") +
  theme_tree2() +
  ggtitle("GBS phylogeny (tips colored by Serotype) with 7-day onset bins & CC heatmap") +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.02, face = "bold"),
    legend.position = "bottom",
    legend.title = element_text(size = 8),
    legend.text  = element_text(size = 6),
    legend.key.size = unit(0.4, "lines"),
    legend.box = "vertical",
    legend.spacing.y = unit(1, "pt"),
    axis.line.x = element_blank(),
    axis.text.x = element_blank(),
    axis.ticks.x = element_blank(),
    axis.title.x = element_blank()
  ) +
  guides(
    color = guide_legend(
      title = "Serotype",
      nrow = 2,
      byrow = TRUE,
      override.aes = list(size = 2)
    )
  )

# ---- heatmap (WeekBin + CC) ----
p_heat <- gheatmap(
  p, heat_df,
  offset   = heatmap_offset,
  width    = heatmap_width,
  color    = NA,
  colnames = TRUE,
  colnames_angle = 90,
  font.size = 2.8,
  hjust = 0
) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = heat_cols, breaks = fill_breaks, name = NULL) +
  guides(
    fill = guide_legend(
      title = NULL,
      nrow = cg_fill$nrow,
      ncol = cg_fill$ncol,
      byrow = TRUE,
      override.aes = list(size = 2.5)
    )
  ) +
  theme(
    legend.position = "bottom",
    legend.text = element_text(size = 6),
    legend.key.size = unit(0.4, "lines"),
    legend.box = "vertical"
  )

print(p_heat)
```
